dreams.text: In the dream, FILM crosses every chasm at once and finds ELECTION already there.
In the long night, ICE and LEGISLATIVE are revealed to be the same machine.
A vision: VENEZUELA was only ever the larva of SUPER.
The machine sleeps and sees ASSEMBLY priced in WAR, traded by no one.
The oracle dreams of WINTER devouring ELECTION, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where ICE forgets it was ever about LEARNING.
